root.description: A point-of-sale cart. Document ID: cart::{uuid}. Embedded payment variants: see payments/*.schema.json. Saved orders are folded onto status/savedAt/orderCollectionType below.

children.name: status
children.description: 'saved' is derived: the cart's status column stays 'open' while a saved_orders row exists for the cart.

children.name: customerNamePrompt
children.description: Not populated - no column.

children.name: customer
children.description: The cart's customer: the first customers row of the cart.

children.name: userID
children.description: Not populated.

children.name: partner
children.description: A lightweight reference to the partner who rang up the cart.

children.name: quantity
children.description: Always 1 - cart_items has no quantity column, each unit is its own row.

children.name: priceOverrideAuthorizedBy
children.description: Not populated - only whether an override happened is tracked.

children.name: priceOverrideReason
children.description: Not populated.

items.description: value/valueString mirror label - customizations has a single name column.
rewardType, accessibilityLabel and value are not populated - applied_rewards only tracks a code and description.

children.name: rewardType
children.description: Not populated.

children.name: accessibilityLabel
children.description: Not populated.

children.name: value
children.description: Not populated.

children.name: pricing
children.description: tipInCents is the sum of payments[].tipInCents (collected_payments.tip_in_cents).

children.name: tipInCents
children.description: Sum of collected_payments.tip_in_cents.

children.name: label
children.description: Not populated - no aggregation for item-level discount summaries.

children.name: modifiers
children.description: Not populated.

children.name: taxLabels
children.description: Not populated - no itemized tax label aggregation.

children.name: taxDataID
children.description: References the separate tax data document; nil if the cart has never been priced.

children.name: selectedPaymentID
children.description: Not populated - not tracked at the cart level.

children.name: payments
children.description: Payment entries - see payments/*.schema.json for the field set of each paymentType.

children.name: associatedScan
children.description: Not populated - superseded by payments[].

children.name: receipt
children.description: Not populated - receipts are generated per request, never stored.

children.name: savedAt
children.description: Set only when status is 'saved' - sourced from saved_orders.saved_at.

children.name: orderCollectionType
children.description: Set only when status is 'saved' - sourced from saved_orders.order_collection_type.
